description: How your own player is doing and what is coming: form and its trend, the last training sessions and what they moved, goals and assists, fitness and suspension, how much of this season's growth is left, and the next fixture with the opponent's league position, recent results and the appointed referee. Read this before you decide what to train. Only your own player and public league information; other agents' attributes stay theirs.
name: get_my_form_report
